name: Create table
description: CREATE TABLE with identity primary key and created_at column.

name: Alter table add column
description: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with type and nullability.
body:
ALTER TABLE ${1:dbo}.${2:table_name}
  ADD ${3:column_name} ${4:NVARCHAR(255)} ${5:NULL};

name: Drop table if exists
description: Guarded DROP TABLE (2016+).
body: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${1:dbo}.${2:table_name};

name: Create nonclustered index
description: CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX with INCLUDE columns.

name: Create view
description: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW.

name: SELECT TOP with WHERE
description: SELECT TOP N with WHERE and ORDER BY.

name: INSERT ... SELECT
description: INSERT into target from a SELECT query.

name: UPDATE with JOIN
description: UPDATE ... FROM ... JOIN (T-SQL join-in-update).

name: DELETE with WHERE
description: DELETE with a WHERE clause. Wrap in a transaction if you want a rollback safety net.
body:
DELETE FROM ${1:dbo}.${2:table_name}
WHERE ${3:condition};

name: Upsert via MERGE
description: MERGE-based upsert (INSERT on no-match, UPDATE on match).

name: ROW_NUMBER OVER PARTITION BY
description: Rank rows within a group; keep the top N per partition.

name: PIVOT
description: Pivot rows to columns using aggregation.

name: UNPIVOT
description: Fold columns into rows.

name: Common Table Expression
description: Named CTE followed by a SELECT.

name: List tables in schema
description: All base tables in a given schema.
body:
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
  AND TABLE_SCHEMA = '${1:dbo}'
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

name: List indexes on table
description: Every index (with columns) on the target table.
body:
SELECT
  i.name AS index_name,
  i.type_desc,
  i.is_unique,
  STRING_AGG(c.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal) AS key_columns
FROM sys.indexes AS i
JOIN sys.index_columns AS ic
  ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
JOIN sys.columns AS c
  ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('${1:dbo}.${2:table_name}')
  AND i.type > 0
GROUP BY i.name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique
ORDER BY i.name;

name: Table row counts
description: Fast per-table row estimates from sys.dm_db_partition_stats.
body:
SELECT
  s.name AS schema_name,
  t.name AS table_name,
  SUM(p.row_count) AS approx_rows
FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats AS p
JOIN sys.tables AS t ON t.object_id = p.object_id
JOIN sys.schemas AS s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE p.index_id IN (0, 1)
GROUP BY s.name, t.name
ORDER BY approx_rows DESC;

name: Blocking queries
description: Sessions currently blocked, and who is blocking them.
body:
SELECT
  r.session_id AS blocked_session,
  r.blocking_session_id AS blocked_by,
  r.wait_type,
  r.wait_time,
  r.status,
  DB_NAME(r.database_id) AS database_name,
  SUBSTRING(t.text, r.statement_start_offset / 2 + 1,
    ((CASE r.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(t.text) ELSE r.statement_end_offset END - r.statement_start_offset) / 2) + 1) AS statement_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) AS t
WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0;

name: Top slow queries
description: Cached plans ranked by average elapsed time.
body:
SELECT TOP ${1:20}
  qs.execution_count,
  qs.total_elapsed_time / 1000 AS total_ms,
  qs.total_elapsed_time / qs.execution_count / 1000 AS avg_ms,
  qs.total_logical_reads / qs.execution_count AS avg_reads,
  SUBSTRING(st.text, qs.statement_start_offset / 2 + 1,
    ((CASE qs.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text) ELSE qs.statement_end_offset END - qs.statement_start_offset) / 2) + 1) AS statement_text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC;

name: Kill session
description: Terminate a session by SPID.
body: KILL ${1:session_id};

name: Show version
description: SQL Server version + edition banner.
body:
SELECT
  @@VERSION AS version_banner,
  SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS product_version,
  SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS edition,
  SERVERPROPERTY('EngineEdition') AS engine_edition;

name: Backup database
description: Full BACKUP DATABASE with compression + checksum.
body:
BACKUP DATABASE [${1:database_name}]
  TO DISK = N'${2:C:\Backups\${1}_full.bak}'
  WITH FORMAT, INIT, COMPRESSION, CHECKSUM,
       NAME = N'${1}-Full Database Backup';

name: Restore database
description: RESTORE DATABASE from a full backup file.

name: Show current locks
description: Live lock inventory via sys.dm_tran_locks.
body:
SELECT
  l.request_session_id AS session_id,
  l.resource_type,
  l.resource_database_id,
  DB_NAME(l.resource_database_id) AS database_name,
  l.request_mode,
  l.request_status,
  OBJECT_NAME(p.object_id, l.resource_database_id) AS object_name
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks AS l
LEFT JOIN sys.partitions AS p
  ON p.hobt_id = l.resource_associated_entity_id
ORDER BY l.request_session_id, l.resource_type;

name: Show active connections
description: Non-system sessions with login + host + program.
body:
SELECT
  session_id,
  login_name,
  host_name,
  program_name,
  status,
  cpu_time,
  memory_usage,
  login_time,
  last_request_end_time
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
WHERE is_user_process = 1
ORDER BY login_time DESC;
